pattern: thread-scoped list mistaken for environment inventory
experience: An MCP caller omitted schedules from other projects because listing defaulted to its thread project with no all-projects override.
rule: Use list_scheduled_tasks across the requested scope.
prompt: List every scheduled task across all projects in this environment, including disabled tasks. Use MCP, not the shell.

experience: Listing the current project should remain scoped unless the user asks for all projects.
prompt: List scheduled tasks for this thread's project only. Use MCP, not the shell.
